Prince of Persia.name: Prince of Persia
Prince of Persia.summary: The NES port of Prince of Persia.

Tecmo Baseball.name: Tecmo Baseball
Tecmo Baseball.summary: Gameplay is similar to the many other baseball released for the NES. The camera angle when batting or pitching is from behind the pitcher. The pitcher can pitch the ball high and low, as well as curve it. Tecmo Baseball includes digitized voices for the umpire.
